cover_letter.greeting: Dear NBCUniversal Operations & Technology Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role supporting Operations & Technology at NBCUniversal. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested in this role because O&T is a shared service across media, production and technology, so the budget and headcount work touches how the whole company runs.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and handled reconciliation with 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on marketing-channel budget allocation and prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership.

That maps to the annual budget, quarterly forecasts and headcount reporting on your team. I also have SAP experience and strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, and I enjoy simplifying a reporting process once I understand it. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role in Operations & Technology at NBCUniversal. At Lenovo I built forecasts and variance analyses on budget reallocation, and at Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting and close. I'd love to hear how the team works. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
